text: Like Khan et al. (2024), the authors track the relationship between debater skill and judge accuracy on self-play debates, but they measure skill as a model's win rate against other training checkpoints. They report a positive relationship for debate, with a 4% absolute increase in judge accuracy after debate training.
title: Arnesen et al. adopt Khan et al.'s skill-vs-accuracy analysis, measuring skill across checkpoints
